releaseNotes: Redesign Console screen UI with new layout and functionality
changelog: Replaced entire ConsoleScreen.kt file with a new design.
Introduced a hero card displaying server status, CPU, memory, and disk usage.
Added toggle cards for Auto Scroll and Prevent Sleep features.
Implemented filter chips for log visibility control.
Enhanced terminal log display with improved formatting and filtering.
Integrated quick commands for efficient command execution.
Maintained existing functionality for command history navigation, pull-to-refresh, and confirmation dialogs for power actions.
Ensured compatibility with existing unit tests and build configurations.
